DAXExpression: VAR Carrier =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[CarrierCode],         "All / Multiple Carriers"     ) VAR Origin =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[OriginAirport],         "All / Multiple Origins"     ) RETURN     "Reported Cancellation Reasons | "         & Carrier & " | " & Origin

VAR Carrier =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[CarrierCode],         "All / Multiple Carriers"     ) VAR Origin =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[OriginAirport],         "All / Multiple Origins"     ) VAR Destination =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[DestinationAirport],         "All / Multiple Destinations"     ) RETURN     "Reported Delay Causes | "         & Carrier & " | "         & Origin & " -> " & Destination         & " | Arrivals >=15 min"

VAR Carrier =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[CarrierCode],         "All / Multiple Carriers"     ) VAR Period =     IF(         ISFILTERED(DimDate[YearMonth]),         CONCATENATEX(             VALUES(DimDate[YearMonth]),             DimDate[YearMonth],             ", ",             DimDate[YearMonth],             ASC         ),         "All Loaded Dates"     ) RETURN     "Airline Operational Performance | "         & Carrier & " | " & Period

SWITCH(     SELECTEDVALUE(DimDelayCause[CauseCode]),     "CARRIER", [Carrier Delay Minutes 15 Plus],     "LATE", [Late Aircraft Delay Minutes 15 Plus],     "NAS", [NAS Delay Minutes 15 Plus],     "WEATHER", [Weather Delay Minutes 15 Plus],     "SECURITY", [Security Delay Minutes 15 Plus],     BLANK() )

VAR Carrier =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[CarrierCode],         "All / Multiple Carriers"     ) VAR Origin =     SELECTEDVALUE(         FactFlights[OriginAirport],         "All / Multiple Origins"     ) RETURN     "Monthly Arrival Delay Rate | "         & Carrier & " | " & Origin         & " vs Carrier Overall"
[Total Arrival Delay Minutes 15 Plus]     - [Reported Cause Minutes 15 Plus]
DIVIDE(     [Arrival Minus Reported Cause Minutes],     [Total Arrival Delay Minutes 15 Plus] )
DIVIDE(     [Total Arrival Delay Minutes 15 Plus],     [Valid Arrival Records] )

MeasureName: Missing Arrival Delay on Regular Flights
DAXExpression: COALESCE(     CALCULATE(         COUNTROWS(FactFlights),         FactFlights[IsCancelled] = 0,         FactFlights[IsDiverted] = 0,         ISBLANK(FactFlights[ArrivalDelayMinutes])     ),     0 )
DIVIDE(     [Reported Cause Minutes 15 Plus],     [Total Arrival Delay Minutes 15 Plus] )
[Carrier Delay Minutes 15 Plus]     + [Weather Delay Minutes 15 Plus]     + [NAS Delay Minutes 15 Plus]     + [Security Delay Minutes 15 Plus]     + [Late Aircraft Delay Minutes 15 Plus]
